Get started

Install in Foundry

  1. From Foundry’s Setup screen, open Add-on Modules → Install Module.
  2. Paste the manifest URL below into Manifest URL and select Install.
  3. Launch your world and enable Ugmuls Character Workshop in Manage Modules.
  4. Check D&D5e → Configure Sources and ensure the importing user can access the required compendiums.
  5. Refresh clients and open Actors → Import D&D Beyond.

Foundry installation manifest ↗

https://github.com/Ugmul-dnd/Ugmuls-Character-Workshop/releases/latest/download/module.json

This manifest installs the latest published release. No D&D Beyond login credentials or personal service token are required.

Before you install

Requirements and access

RequirementWhat you need
Foundry VTTVersion 14
D&D5e system6.0.6 or later
Source contentInstalled, approved compendiums containing the character’s content; books are not included.
Importing userPermission to create actors and view the relevant compendiums.
Local artworkFile upload permission to save portraits in the world’s token-images folder.

Designed to supplement Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation, while remaining independently installable. No Tokenizer dependency is required for portrait saving.

If a GM can find content that a player cannot, check the compendium’s ownership settings. Some books hide magic-item packs from players by default. Observer access allows a player to view the source entries.

v0.2.0 · Beta

A one-time import.
A final review before play.

This beta imports public D&D Beyond characters using your existing Foundry sources. It supports source matching, replacements, native advancement assistance, equipment and spells, proficiency alignment, local artwork, and a final comparison log.

No new gameplay automation is supplied for unknown content. There are no built-in macros or implementations of unknown features, skills, or weapons. A Needs GM Review placeholder carries a name and review note for the GM to finish.

The module creates new actors; it does not update or synchronize existing characters. Direct proficiency alignment may not preserve every advancement link. Legacy subclasses are not converted to revised rules.

Public loading and artwork retrieval depend on the shared import service and D&D Beyond availability. Saved or pasted JSON remains an alternative for character data. If a local portrait download fails, the hosted image remains in use and the failure is logged.

Read the published release notes →

Help improve the beta

Report what you find.

When reporting an issue, include your module, Foundry, and D&D5e versions, the affected feature, what happened, and any relevant console error. A public character number can help reproduce an import problem.

Please do not post private character exports, credentials, or other personal information. The final review log is a useful starting point for identifying the entry that needs attention.
